description: This PHP class defines the AWS SavingsPlansClient, used to interact with the AWS Savings Plans service. It provides method annotations for various operations like creating, deleting, describing savings plans and related resources, as well as tagging functionalities.

classes.name: SavingsPlansClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with AWS Savings Plans service, extending the generic AwsClient class.

methods.name: createSavingsPlanAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Savings Plan.

methods.name: deleteQueuedSavingsPlanAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a queued Savings Plan.

methods.name: describeSavingsPlansOfferingRates
methods.description: Describes the rates offerings for Savings Plans.

methods.name: describeSavingsPlansOfferingRatesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes Savings Plans offering rates.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a specified resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
